# Mayfly tuning keys

Every key below is optional. An omitted key keeps whatever the dialect -- or the
preset -- already chose, which is what makes an empty document a no-op. Unknown
keys are rejected rather than ignored, because a misspelled knob that was
silently dropped would run a fit at the default while you believed you had
tuned it.

Keys marked with a dialect apply only to that dialect. Passing one to a
different dialect is an error, not a no-op: mayfly ignores the fields of
variants it is not running, so the value would land on the configuration,
change nothing, and leave you believing the run was tuned.

See [optimizer.md](optimizer.md) for how the document fits into a run.

## Shared

| Key                     | Type  | Range                | Description                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | ----- | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `npop`                  | int   | >= 2                 | Number of male mayflies. Mating pairs the k-th best male with the k-th best female, so this also caps the usable offspring count.                              |
| `npopf`                 | int   | >= 2                 | Number of female mayflies.                                                                                                                                     |
| `g`                     | float | [0, 1]               | Inertia weight on the velocity update.                                                                                                                         |
| `g_damp`                | float | > 0                  | Per-iteration multiplier applied to the inertia weight.                                                                                                        |
| `a1`                    | float | >= 0                 | Attraction coefficient towards a mayfly's own best position.                                                                                                   |
| `a2`                    | float | >= 0                 | Attraction coefficient towards the global best position.                                                                                                       |
| `a3`                    | float | >= 0                 | Attraction coefficient between mating partners.                                                                                                                |
| `beta`                  | float | > 0                  | Exponent of the distance-based visibility term.                                                                                                                |
| `dance`                 | float | any finite           | Random-walk amplitude of the best males' nuptial dance.                                                                                                        |
| `dance_damp`            | float | any finite           | Per-iteration multiplier applied to the nuptial dance amplitude.                                                                                               |
| `fl`                    | float | any finite           | Random-walk amplitude of unmated females.                                                                                                                      |
| `fl_damp`               | float | any finite           | Per-iteration multiplier applied to the female random walk.                                                                                                    |
| `nc`                    | int   | >= -1                | Crossover offspring per iteration. -1 (mayfly.NCAuto) derives the count from nc_ratio, 0 disables crossover entirely, and a positive value is taken literally. |
| `nc_ratio`              | float | >= 0                 | Offspring count as a fraction of the male population, used only when nc is -1.                                                                                 |
| `nm`                    | int   | >= 0                 | Mutants drawn from the offspring each iteration. Zero derives 5% of npop.                                                                                      |
| `mu`                    | float | [0, 1]               | Per-dimension probability that a mutant is perturbed.                                                                                                          |
| `crossover_gamma`       | float | any finite           | Blend-crossover expansion factor. A non-positive value falls back to the default.                                                                              |
| `selection`             | enum  | `tournament`, `rank` | How crossover pairs parents: "rank" mates the k-th best of each sex, "tournament" draws tournament_size candidates and mates the fittest.                      |
| `tournament_size`       | int   | >= 0                 | Candidates drawn per tournament. Used only when selection is "tournament".                                                                                     |
| `vel_max`               | float | any finite           | Upper velocity clamp. Zero lets mayfly derive one from the search box.                                                                                         |
| `vel_min`               | float | any finite           | Lower velocity clamp. Zero lets mayfly derive one from the search box.                                                                                         |
| `target_cost`           | float | any finite           | Stop once the best cost reaches this value. Omitting the key disables the target, which is why zero is a usable target rather than "off".                      |
| `min_improvement`       | float | >= 0                 | Cost reduction required to reset the stagnation counter.                                                                                                       |
| `stagnation_iterations` | int   | >= 0                 | Stop after this many iterations without a sufficient improvement. Zero disables it.                                                                            |
| `min_iterations`        | int   | >= 0                 | Iterations that must complete before either stopping rule may fire.                                                                                            |
| `epochs`                | int   | >= 1                 | How many optimizer epochs the wrapper runs per fit.                                                                                                            |
| `restarts`              | int   | >= 0                 | How many times the wrapper restarts from a fresh population.                                                                                                   |

## DESMA

| Key                | Type  | Range | Description                                                                  |
| ------------------ | ----- | ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `elite_count`      | int   | >= 0  | Number of elites that receive the differential-evolution step.               |
| `search_range`     | float | >= 0  | Initial elite search radius. Zero lets mayfly derive it from the search box. |
| `enlarge_factor`   | float | > 0   | Multiplier applied to the search range after a successful elite step.        |
| `reduction_factor` | float | > 0   | Multiplier applied to the search range after a failed elite step.            |

## OLCE-MA

| Key                 | Type  | Range  | Description                                                                                                            |
| ------------------- | ----- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `orthogonal_factor` | float | [0, 1] | Weight of the orthogonal learning stage. Zero disables the stage and frees its share of the evaluation budget.         |
| `chaos_factor`      | float | [0, 1] | Initial chaotic search radius, decaying to zero. Zero disables the stage and frees its share of the evaluation budget. |

## EOBBMA

| Key                      | Type  | Range  | Description                                                             |
| ------------------------ | ----- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `levy_alpha`             | float | (0, 2] | Stability index of the Levy flight. Smaller values give heavier tails.  |
| `levy_beta`              | float | > 0    | Scale of the Levy flight step.                                          |
| `opposition_rate`        | float | [0, 1] | Fraction of elites that receive opposition-based learning.              |
| `elite_opposition_count` | int   | >= 0   | Number of top solutions considered elite for opposition-based learning. |

## GSASMA

| Key                   | Type  | Range                                  | Description                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------- | ----- | -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `initial_temperature` | float | > 0                                    | Starting temperature of the simulated-annealing acceptance test.                                                                 |
| `cooling_rate`        | float | (0, 1)                                 | Per-iteration temperature multiplier. Must stay strictly inside (0,1) so the schedule actually cools without collapsing at once. |
| `cooling_schedule`    | enum  | `exponential`, `linear`, `logarithmic` | Shape of the temperature decay.                                                                                                  |
| `golden_factor`       | float | any finite                             | Weight of the golden-sine step.                                                                                                  |

## HMMA

| Key                        | Type  | Range       | Description                                                                 |
| -------------------------- | ----- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cauchy_mutation_rate`     | float | [0, 1]      | Share of mutations drawn from a Cauchy rather than a Gaussian distribution. |
| `apply_obl_to_global_best` | bool  | true, false | Apply opposition-based learning to the global best every tenth iteration.   |

## MPMA

| Key                   | Type  | Range                              | Description                                                           |
| --------------------- | ----- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `median_weight`       | float | [0, 1]                             | Balance between the population median and the global best as a guide. |
| `gravity_type`        | enum  | `linear`, `exponential`, `sigmoid` | Shape of the non-linear gravity coefficient decay.                    |
| `use_weighted_median` | bool  | true, false                        | Weight the median by fitness instead of taking the plain median.      |

## AOBLMOA

| Key                      | Type  | Range  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------ | ----- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `aquila_weight`          | float | [0, 1] | Probability that an individual takes an Aquila step instead of a mayfly step. Deprecated: the published algorithm has no such knob, and omitting the key lets mayfly decide the branch by its fitness test instead. |
| `opposition_probability` | float | [0, 1] | Probability that a solution receives opposition-based learning. Read only by the pre-paper branch draw: AOBLMOA itself opposes every offspring, ungated.                                                            |
| `archive_size`           | int   | >= 0   | Capacity of the caller-managed Pareto archive.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `strategy_switch`        | int   | >= 0   | Iteration at which Aquila switches from exploration to exploitation. Zero lets mayfly derive two thirds of the iteration budget.                                                                                    |
